newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia names new UN disarmament ambassador.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia names new UN disarmament ambassador.

text.p: The Australia government on Thursday named a career diplomat as its new ambassador for disarmament.
Foreign Minister Alexander Downer said in a statement John Campbell would this month succeed Richard Starr, who has held the United Nations-based post since 1994.

Campbell, an assistant secretary in the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade, has served in several Australian diplomatic missions and was ambasador to Israel from 1987 to 1990 and ambassador to Laos from 1984 to 1987.
In his new post, Campbell would put Australia's position in a range of disarmament negotiations, covering nuclear, biological and conventional weapons, Downer said.
